summary.name: E2B
summary.one_liner: E2B is an isolated cloud sandbox platform that gives each AI agent session its own Linux microVM for running code, browsing, and using a desktop.
use_cases: Run AI-generated code safely in isolated machines
Let agents use a desktop with mouse, keyboard and screen
Run parallel agent evaluations and benchmarks
Reinforcement learning rollouts across many sandboxes
Deploy agent infrastructure in your own AWS, GCP or Azure account
Serve apps built by coding agents
summary.what_it_does: E2B provides an isolated Linux microVM per agent session, with an API and SDK to run code, control network egress, keep files, hold secrets, and pause or fork the machine. Code Interpreter adds runCode() for executing Python or JavaScript and returning charts, tables, and images. Desktop mode adds a screen with mouse and keyboard for computer-use agents, streamed live. It can run in E2B's cloud or inside a customer's AWS, GCP, or Azure account (BYOC). The page says the runtime is built on Firecracker with snapshot-based booting, and that the core runtime is Apache-2.0 licensed and self-hostable via E2B Embed.
notable: One isolated Firecracker-based microVM per agent session, booted from snapshots
Apache-2.0 runtime that can be self-hosted via E2B Embed
Code Interpreter (runCode) and Desktop computer-use modes
SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance stated; US, EU, and APAC regions
caveats: Paid tiers ($150/month Pro and custom Enterprise) plus usage costs; free Hobby tier has session and concurrency limits
BYOC and custom deployments are enterprise options
Free tier limited to 1-hour sessions and 20 concurrent sandboxes
